Migration 0143_event-dedup-app-key.sql re-adds event_dedup_pkey as PRIMARY KEY (app_id, event_type, event_id) (规划/02 §12.3: business unique keys start with app_id). Safe with data: app_id NOT NULL since 0140 and the old key (event_type, event_id) was stricter, so existing rows always satisfy the new key; the cost is the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock during the index build, removed before go-live under FU-MIGRATION-INDEX-CONCURRENTLY. db/schema.sql: only the pkey line changes (local snapshot, D10-1553 fixed practice; main's schema / migrations unchanged since). recordEvents: in-batch dedupe (first wins, duplicates counted as before), inserts in ascending (app_id, event_type, event_id) order (no 40P01 between reverse-order concurrent batches), ON CONFLICT on the new key, clock read once per call.
